strategies.name: Baseline Unrolled Eight All-Reduces
strategies.desc: Directly implements 8 sequential all-reduce stages with interleaved local bidiagonal coupling and undoing operations. Each stage performs one all-reduce (8 total dispatches) with full W*S payload. Represents the reference approach with no structural optimization—maximum clarity, no fusion, predictable latency.

strategies.name: Fused Local Ops Single-Buffer
strategies.desc: Merges all local coupling/undoing arithmetic into vectorized operations between all-reduces, reusing a single buffer throughout. Still 8 all-reduce dispatches but reduces memory allocation overhead and potential cache misses. Trades off code complexity for improved memory locality without changing collective count.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter + All-Gather Decomposition
strategies.desc: Decomposes each all-reduce into reduce-scatter followed by all-gather (16 total collectives). Allows overlap of local bidiagonal operations during the gather phase, potentially hiding computation in communication. Increases dispatch count but enables better pipelining on hierarchical network topologies with 224 ranks.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction
strategies.desc: Exploits the 224-rank structure by performing intra-node reductions first, then inter-node all-reduces, leveraging faster local interconnects. Each of 8 stages splits into local+global phases (16-24 dispatches depending on implementation). Optimizes for multi-node bandwidth hierarchy at cost of increased orchestration complexity.

strategies.name: Chunked Pipelined All-Reduce Waves
strategies.desc:
Splits the W*S tensor into independent chunks and pipelines multiple all-reduce operations across chunks, overlapping communication of chunk i with computation (coupling/undoing) of chunk i-1. Maintains 8 logical stages but increases dispatches (8*C for C chunks). Trades latency for throughput by exploiting asynchronous dispatch capabilities.
